children: On most measures, $24 bln Mistral trails Anthropic and OpenAI. The only exception is its valuation, which as a multiple of annualised sales seems to be in a similar ballpark to the Americans. The Paris-based outfit may be benefiting from its position as a geopolitical hedge.
Full view will be published shortly.
Follow Liam Proud on Bluesky and LinkedIn.

France's Mistral on September 8 said it had raised €3 billion at a valuation of around €21 billion, in what the three-year-old artificial intelligence company said was the biggest equity funding round by a privately owned European technology firm.
Mistral said that Samsung Electronics led the round, joined by co-leads PSG Equity and the Scaleup Europe Fund, a European Union backed vehicle managed by EQT.
The company's finance chief told Reuters that it was on track for $1 billion of annual recurring revenue by the end of the year.
